We are a multifaceted music company specializing in live audio services and recording/mixing/mastering. We are 2x nominated provincial award finalists, 3x National Award finalists & 2x  national award winner. 

We have music playlists that support local artists & artists all over the world in multiple genres alongside our TV series, YouTube series & mental health live streams. 

We strongly believe that success is achieved by passion for what you do and relationships that help make it a reality. That's why here, it's always Your Sound, Our Passion!! Which means we love every minute of the many things we do here that our passion always is with you in every project we assist with.
